run_seq2seq_qa_finetune: run seq2seq model fine-tuning for question answering on SQuAD dataset using HuggingFace Trainer
create_model_load_seq2seq: create a seq2seq model from pretrained checkpoint with custom tokenizer and configuration arguments
build_dataset_preprocess_qa: build preprocessing pipeline that tokenizes question-context pairs and generates labels for seq2seq question answering
test_eval_model_squad: test the fine-tuned model on SQuAD validation set and compute metrics using the evaluate library
predict_answers_generate: predict answers from test dataset using model.generate with configurable beam search and max length
